name: Marine Le Pen
bio: Marion Anne Perrine "Marine" Le Pen, born 5 August 1968 in Neuilly-sur-Seine, is a French lawyer and politician who led the Front National (renamed Rassemblement National in 2018) from 2011 to 2021 and has been a deputy for the Pas-de-Calais since 2017, currently presiding over the RN group in the Assemblée nationale. The daughter of FN founder Jean-Marie Le Pen, she stood for President of France three times (2012, 2017, 2022), reaching the second round in 2017 and 2022 against Emmanuel Macron. In March 2025 she was convicted at first instance of embezzlement of European Parliament funds and sentenced to a five-year ineligibility with provisional execution; her appeal was heard in early 2026, with a verdict scheduled for 7 July 2026.
